text: The Budget Committee will hear public presentations on the 2021 Capital and Operating Budgets on January 25, 2020 from 9:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Meetings of the Budget Committee to hear public presentations on the 2021 Capital and Operating Budgets have been scheduled as follows: Monday, January 25, 2021: 9:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.; 1:30 p.m. to 4:30 p.m.; and 6:00 p.m. onwards. Tuesday, January 26, 2021: 9:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.; 1:30 p.m. to 4:30 p.m.; and 6:00 p.m. onwards.
The Budget Committee: 1. Received the public presentations on the 2021 Capital and Operating Budgets for information.
